name: triage
description: Blind judges sort a list of issues in batches: fix, close, ask or later, each with why; Claude decides

stages.prompt:
Here the bar is triage. For each issue below, by the id it is given, return an action: fix (real and worth doing now), close (not real, done, or not worth it), ask (it needs the user's answer) or later; and why, in a sentence.

{item}
